verified: All three Settings cases reject release, Store CRX, incomplete or absent CI development selection before release download and measured package/browser admission.
A complete CI development run/artifact pair reaches the existing provenance route; downstream numeric/exclusive-mode and real CI receipt checks remain enforced.
The added regression is wired into CI and executes the actual YAML shell rather than duplicating its implementation.
limitations: The new test proves provenance-mode admission, not remote artifact freshness or fixture matching; those remain the existing importer and CI-development receipt checks.
This patch review is not a live Settings product acceptance.
